syllabus_topics: Introduction. Culture, ethics and organizational structure.
assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) in the normal period is the sum of two mini-tests (4.5 points each), the IST Management Challenge (2 points), and a 1-hour exam (9 points), with no minimum grade for each component. For the resit period, a 1.5-hour exam covering all material constitutes 100% of the final grade. The better of the two periods' grades (normal or resit) counts. For special period students and working students, a single 1.5-hour exam covering all material accounts for 100% of the final grade. Only explicitly indicated material is allowed during exams.
